confidence_bands.label: Verified Official
confidence_bands.description: Official or primary authority source directly supports the claim, freshness requirement is satisfied, and no unresolved conflict exists.

confidence_bands.label: High Trusted Recent
confidence_bands.description: Trusted source supports the claim and is recent enough, but source is not the primary official authority.

confidence_bands.label: Medium Needs Review
confidence_bands.description: Source is useful but incomplete, indirect, unsupported by primary evidence, or operationally sensitive enough to need Commander/operator review.

confidence_bands.label: Low Unverified or Stale
confidence_bands.description: Source is old, unclear, weak, unattributed, only a lead, or not current enough for the claim.

confidence_bands.label: Blocked or Unsafe
confidence_bands.description: Source or claim is unsafe, privacy-invasive, manipulative, unlawful, conflicts with Kingsmen law, or lacks evidence for official action.
